title: Siege of Agadir (1533)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Agadir (1533)", at revision 1370738512, opens: "The siege of Agadir in 1533 was a military confrontation started by the troops of Mohammed al-Shaykh against the Portuguese fortress of Santa Cruz do Cabo da Gué. The Portuguese resisted the siege." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q126727785, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1533 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
